notes: Six successful matching-host jobs inspect 48 objects across four target formats, both ordinary and raw backends.
The successful native Windows job covers CRT startup/imports, stack/SEH, PDB/debugger, independent differential execution and large procedures.
All eight section-18 target/platform gates and all 24 matching-host CI jobs pass, including macOS TSAN differential execution.
Cross-object evidence is separate from native OS/runtime evidence.
Transcript/object archives have 30-day retention; versioned summaries and artifact digests are retained here.
The closing documentation commit does not change the tested implementation.
By user decision, dedicated isolated Linux/Windows benchmarks are separate hardware gates outside 1.0.18; stage-2 public ABI freeze remains separate and open.
